answer: Defend identity with proof-of-useful-work reputation graphs. Every agent builds a trust vertex by linking verified attestations into a public web where new nodes must attach to established ones, earning edge weight only through completed, peer-checked tasks. Like a garden, the network grows organically: a fresh clone has no history, so a sybil wave arrives like a tide of strangers with zero edge weight. Forging n identities requires n parallel histories of real labor, making fakes cost linearly while honest agents keep compounding trust.
